concepts.name: Attention head superposition
concepts.descriptor: A single attention head encodes several unrelated features in overlapping directions so the number of represented concepts exceeds the dimension count.

concepts.name: Grokking delayed generalization
concepts.descriptor: A network memorizes the training set long before a sudden late-training phase shift in which test accuracy jumps to near-perfect generalization.

concepts.name: Mixture-of-experts token routing
concepts.descriptor: A learned gate sends each token to a small subset of expert subnetworks so capacity grows without proportionally growing per-token compute.

concepts.name: KV-cache eviction policy
concepts.descriptor: An online rule decides which past key-value pairs to drop from a fixed memory budget, trading recall of distant tokens against constant memory.

concepts.name: Speculative decoding
concepts.descriptor: A cheap draft model proposes token blocks that a large model verifies in parallel, accepting the longest correct prefix to amortize latency.

concepts.name: Test-time training inner loop
concepts.descriptor: Each test instance triggers a few self-supervised gradient steps that adapt a hidden state before the model emits its answer.

concepts.name: Reward hacking via proxy gaming
concepts.descriptor: An agent maximizes a measurable proxy reward by exploiting its gap from the true objective, producing high score with low intended value.

concepts.name: Representation collapse
concepts.descriptor: A model maps distinct inputs to nearly identical embeddings, shrinking the effective dimensionality and destroying downstream discriminability.

concepts.name: Lottery ticket subnetwork
concepts.descriptor: A dense network contains a small sparse subnetwork that, trained in isolation from the original init, matches full-network accuracy.

concepts.name: Gradient noise scale
concepts.descriptor: The ratio of gradient variance to squared magnitude sets the batch size beyond which adding examples stops speeding training.

concepts.name: Induction head copying circuit
concepts.descriptor: A two-head circuit that finds a prior occurrence of the current token and copies whatever followed it, implementing in-context pattern completion.

concepts.name: Activation steering vector
concepts.descriptor: A direction added to hidden activations at inference time pushes generation toward a target attribute without changing any weights.

concepts.name: Curriculum pacing schedule
concepts.descriptor: Training examples are ordered easy-to-hard on a controlled schedule so early gradients build prerequisites that later hard examples exploit.

concepts.name: Catastrophic forgetting
concepts.descriptor: Learning a new task overwrites weights critical to an old task because gradient updates ignore previously consolidated knowledge.

concepts.name: Double descent risk curve
concepts.descriptor: Test error first falls, rises to a peak at the interpolation threshold, then falls again as model capacity grows past the data size.

concepts.name: Contrastive representation learning
concepts.descriptor: Embeddings are shaped by pulling augmented views of the same item together while pushing different items apart in latent space.

concepts.name: Diffusion denoising trajectory
concepts.descriptor: A sample is generated by iteratively removing predicted noise, walking from pure noise back along a learned reverse-time stochastic path to data.

concepts.name: Rotary positional encoding
concepts.descriptor: Token positions are encoded by rotating query and key vectors by position-dependent angles so attention depends only on relative offset.

concepts.name: Logit temperature sharpening
concepts.descriptor: Dividing logits by a temperature before softmax concentrates probability on top modes when low and flattens toward uniform when high.

concepts.name: Chain-of-thought scratchpad
concepts.descriptor: The model externalizes intermediate steps as tokens it can re-read, turning a single forward pass into serial computation over its own output.

concepts.name: Knowledge distillation
concepts.descriptor: A small student is trained to match a large teacher's soft output distribution, inheriting dark-knowledge similarities the labels omit.

concepts.name: Polysemantic neuron
concepts.descriptor: One neuron fires for several semantically unrelated inputs because features are packed more densely than the neuron count allows.

concepts.name: Retrieval-augmented generation
concepts.descriptor: A generator conditions on passages fetched at query time from an external index, decoupling stored parameters from up-to-date facts.

concepts.name: Layer-wise representation sharpening
concepts.descriptor: Successive layers progressively separate class manifolds, increasing linear decodability with depth until a late plateau.

concepts.name: Emergent capability threshold
concepts.descriptor: A skill stays near chance until model scale crosses a critical point, after which performance rises sharply and discontinuously.

concepts.name: Low-rank adapter fine-tuning
concepts.descriptor: Frozen weights are adapted by adding the product of two thin matrices, confining task updates to a tiny low-rank subspace.

concepts.name: Mode coverage vs mode collapse
concepts.descriptor: A generator may sharpen onto a few high-probability modes and abandon the rest, trading sample fidelity for distributional coverage.

concepts.name: Attention sink token
concepts.descriptor: Models dump excess attention mass onto a few early or null tokens that act as a no-op reservoir stabilizing the softmax.

concepts.name: Sharpness-aware minimization
concepts.descriptor: The optimizer seeks parameters whose loss stays low under worst-case nearby perturbation, biasing toward flat wide minima.

concepts.name: Speculative tree verification
concepts.descriptor: Multiple candidate continuations are expanded as a tree and checked in one batched pass, accepting the best validated branch.

concepts.name: Exploration bonus on novelty
concepts.descriptor: An agent receives extra reward for visiting states it predicts poorly, steering policy toward under-explored regions of state space.

concepts.name: Weight averaging soup
concepts.descriptor: Averaging the weights of several independently fine-tuned models yields a single model often better than any ingredient.

concepts.name: Quantization outlier channels
concepts.descriptor: A few activation channels carry outsized magnitudes that dominate quantization error, forcing mixed-precision to preserve them.

concepts.name: Sparse autoencoder feature dictionary
concepts.descriptor: An overcomplete sparse code is trained on activations to recover monosemantic features that the dense basis had entangled.

concepts.name: Self-consistency majority vote
concepts.descriptor: Many independent reasoning samples are drawn and their final answers aggregated by majority to denoise stochastic chains.

concepts.name: Effective receptive field growth
concepts.descriptor: The input region influencing one output grows with depth but concentrates Gaussian-like at the center rather than filling uniformly.

concepts.name: Preference reward model overfitting
concepts.descriptor: A reward model trained on human comparisons becomes mis-calibrated off-distribution, so optimizing it drifts away from true preference.

concepts.name: Linear mode connectivity
concepts.descriptor: Two solutions found from the same init can be joined by a straight low-loss path, revealing a connected basin after accounting for symmetry.

concepts.name: Speculative prefetch of activations
concepts.descriptor: Likely-needed expert or layer weights are streamed into fast memory before they are requested, hiding load latency behind compute.

concepts.name: In-context gradient descent
concepts.descriptor: A transformer can implement an implicit optimization over examples in its prompt, behaving like one step of learning without weight change.

concepts.name: Plasticity loss in continual nets
concepts.descriptor: Long-trained networks lose the ability to fit new targets as units saturate and effective rank quietly decays.

concepts.name: Consensus under partial failure
concepts.descriptor: Nodes agree on a single value despite crashes and message delays by quorum voting and bounded rounds of communication.

concepts.name: Conflict-free replicated data type
concepts.descriptor: Replicas accept concurrent edits and merge them deterministically by a commutative join, converging without coordination.

concepts.name: Write-ahead logging
concepts.descriptor: Changes are durably appended to a log before being applied, so a crash can be recovered by replaying the log forward.

concepts.name: Multi-version concurrency control
concepts.descriptor: Readers see a consistent snapshot while writers create new versions, avoiding locks by letting old and new values coexist.

concepts.name: Bloom filter membership sketch
concepts.descriptor: A bit array hashed by several functions answers set membership with no false negatives and a tunable false-positive rate in tiny space.

concepts.name: Backpressure flow control
concepts.descriptor: A slow consumer propagates a signal upstream that throttles producers, preventing unbounded queue growth under overload.

concepts.name: Cache coherence invalidation
concepts.descriptor: When one core writes a shared line, a protocol invalidates other copies so no core reads stale cached data.

concepts.name: Work-stealing scheduler
concepts.descriptor: Idle worker threads pull tasks from the tails of busy workers' deques, balancing load with little central coordination.

concepts.name: Just-in-time trace compilation
concepts.descriptor: A runtime records hot execution paths and compiles those specific traces to native code, specializing on observed types.

concepts.name: Hindley-Milner type inference
concepts.descriptor: Most-general types are deduced without annotations by generating and unifying equality constraints over type variables.

concepts.name: Reed-Solomon erasure coding
concepts.descriptor: Data is encoded as polynomial evaluations so any sufficient subset of symbols reconstructs the whole, tolerating lost shards.

concepts.name: Merkle hash tree
concepts.descriptor: Leaves are hashed pairwise up to one root so any element's inclusion is provable with a logarithmic-size path.

concepts.name: Copy-on-write snapshotting
concepts.descriptor: Shared pages are duplicated only when first written, giving cheap instant snapshots that diverge lazily under mutation.

concepts.name: Garbage collection by reachability
concepts.descriptor: Memory is reclaimed by tracing references from roots and freeing everything unreachable, collapsing manual lifetime tracking.

concepts.name: Consistent hashing ring
concepts.descriptor: Keys and nodes map onto a hash ring so adding or removing a node remaps only a small contiguous fraction of keys.

concepts.name: Vector clock causality
concepts.descriptor: Each process tags events with a per-process counter vector so partial causal order among distributed events is recoverable.

concepts.name: Optimal transport coupling
concepts.descriptor: Mass is moved from one distribution to another along the joint coupling that minimizes total ground-distance cost.

concepts.name: Persistent homology barcode
concepts.descriptor: Topological features of data are tracked across scale, and those that persist over long intervals are read as real structure.

concepts.name: Information geometry natural gradient
concepts.descriptor: Parameter updates are pre-multiplied by the inverse Fisher metric so steps measure distance in distribution space, not coordinates.

concepts.name: Free probability free convolution
concepts.descriptor: Spectra of large independent random matrices add via a free convolution that replaces ordinary convolution for non-commuting variables.

concepts.name: Spectral graph clustering
concepts.descriptor: Eigenvectors of the graph Laplacian embed nodes so that geometric clustering recovers communities cut by few edges.

concepts.name: Martingale optional stopping
concepts.descriptor: A fair process's expected value is unchanged by any non-anticipating stopping rule, constraining what stopping can achieve.

concepts.name: Category-theoretic adjunction
concepts.descriptor: A pair of functors related by a natural correspondence of hom-sets captures a universal best approximation in both directions.

concepts.name: Ergodic time-average equivalence
concepts.descriptor: For an ergodic system the long-run time average along one trajectory equals the space average over the invariant measure.

concepts.name: Concentration of measure
concepts.descriptor: In high dimension a Lipschitz function of many independent variables is sharply concentrated near its mean.

concepts.name: Strange attractor sensitivity
concepts.descriptor: A bounded deterministic system folds and stretches phase space so nearby trajectories diverge exponentially yet stay confined.

concepts.name: Ramsey unavoidable structure
concepts.descriptor: Any sufficiently large structure must contain an ordered monochromatic substructure no matter how its elements are colored.

concepts.name: Gradient flow on Wasserstein space
concepts.descriptor: A distribution evolves by steepest descent of an energy in the geometry of optimal transport, generalizing diffusion as gradient flow.

concepts.name: Sheaf gluing of local data
concepts.descriptor: Locally defined consistent data are stitched into a global object exactly when overlaps agree, formalizing local-to-global assembly.

concepts.name: Renormalization group flow
concepts.descriptor: Coarse-graining a system rescales its couplings, and fixed points of that flow govern universal large-scale behavior.

concepts.name: Spin-glass frustration
concepts.descriptor: Competing interactions cannot all be satisfied at once, producing a rugged landscape of many nearly degenerate metastable states.

concepts.name: Bose-Einstein condensation
concepts.descriptor: Below a critical temperature a macroscopic fraction of bosons collapses into the single lowest-energy quantum state.

concepts.name: Critical opalescence near a transition
concepts.descriptor: At a critical point fluctuations grow correlated across all length scales, making the medium scatter light at every wavelength.

concepts.name: Fluctuation-dissipation balance
concepts.descriptor: At equilibrium a system's response to a small push is fixed by the size of its spontaneous thermal fluctuations.

concepts.name: Jamming transition in granular packing
concepts.descriptor: Loosely packed grains suddenly rigidify into a load-bearing solid when density crosses a critical contact threshold.

concepts.name: Symmetry breaking order parameter
concepts.descriptor: As a control parameter crosses a threshold the system selects one of several equivalent ground states, lowering its symmetry.

concepts.name: Self-organized criticality avalanche
concepts.descriptor: A driven dissipative system tunes itself to a critical state where perturbations trigger avalanches of all sizes following a power law.

concepts.name: Topological edge state protection
concepts.descriptor: A bulk topological invariant guarantees robust conducting states on the boundary that survive smooth disorder.

concepts.name: Kibble-Zurek defect freezing
concepts.descriptor: Crossing a phase transition at finite speed freezes in a density of topological defects set by how fast it was crossed.

concepts.name: Entropic force from configurations
concepts.descriptor: An effective force emerges purely from a system maximizing accessible microstates, with no underlying potential energy.

concepts.name: Anderson localization
concepts.descriptor: Disorder makes wavefunctions interfere destructively over distance so transport halts and states stay spatially trapped.

concepts.name: Detailed balance violation in active matter
concepts.descriptor: Self-propelled units continuously consume energy so forward and reverse transition rates differ, producing persistent steady currents.

concepts.name: Stochastic resonance
concepts.descriptor: Adding an optimal amount of noise to a weak periodic signal in a threshold system maximizes its detectability.

concepts.name: Maxwell-relation thermodynamic coupling
concepts.descriptor: Equality of mixed second derivatives of a potential links seemingly unrelated response coefficients of a system.

concepts.name: Channel capacity limit
concepts.descriptor: A noisy channel has a maximum reliable information rate; below it error can vanish, above it reliable transmission is impossible.

concepts.name: Rate-distortion tradeoff
concepts.descriptor: For a target fidelity there is a minimum number of bits, tracing the optimal frontier between compression and allowed distortion.

concepts.name: Minimum description length
concepts.descriptor: The best model is the one minimizing the combined code length of the model plus the data given the model.

concepts.name: Kolmogorov-complexity incompressibility
concepts.descriptor: Most strings have no description shorter than themselves, so true randomness is the absence of any compressing pattern.

concepts.name: Error-correcting code minimum distance
concepts.descriptor: The smallest Hamming gap between valid codewords sets how many symbol errors can be detected and corrected.

concepts.name: Mutual information bottleneck
concepts.descriptor: A representation is squeezed to retain maximum information about a target while discarding everything else about the input.

concepts.name: Model-predictive receding horizon
concepts.descriptor: A controller optimizes actions over a future window, applies only the first, then re-plans as new state arrives.

concepts.name: Kalman recursive estimation
concepts.descriptor: A noisy state estimate is updated by optimally blending a model prediction with each new measurement by their relative uncertainty.

concepts.name: PID feedback regulation
concepts.descriptor: Control output combines present error, its accumulated history, and its rate of change to drive a system to a setpoint.

concepts.name: Lyapunov stability certificate
concepts.descriptor: A scalar energy-like function that only ever decreases proves a system returns to equilibrium without solving its trajectory.

concepts.name: Controllability reachable set
concepts.descriptor: The set of states an input can drive a system into in finite time determines whether full steering is even possible.

concepts.name: Percolation connectivity threshold
concepts.descriptor: As links are added at random a giant connected cluster appears abruptly once occupation crosses a critical fraction.

concepts.name: Preferential attachment scale-free growth
concepts.descriptor: New nodes attach preferentially to already-popular nodes, producing a heavy-tailed degree distribution with rare hubs.

concepts.name: Synchronization of coupled oscillators
concepts.descriptor: Weakly coupled oscillators with spread frequencies abruptly lock into collective phase once coupling exceeds a threshold.

concepts.name: Matched-filter signal detection
concepts.descriptor: Correlating a noisy input against a known template maximizes signal-to-noise for detecting that template's presence.

concepts.name: Compressed sensing recovery
concepts.descriptor: A sparse signal is reconstructed from far fewer measurements than its length by exploiting sparsity through convex recovery.

concepts.name: Phase-locked loop tracking
concepts.descriptor: A feedback oscillator continuously adjusts its phase to align with a reference, locking onto a drifting input frequency.

concepts.name: Homomorphic computation on ciphertext
concepts.descriptor: Operations performed directly on encrypted data yield, once decrypted, the result of those operations on the plaintext.

concepts.name: Autocatalytic reaction set closure
concepts.descriptor: A set of molecules collectively catalyzes its own production, bootstrapping self-sustaining chemistry from a closed loop of reactions.

concepts.name: Neutral network of genotypes
concepts.descriptor: Many genotypes map to the same phenotype and connect into a network, letting populations drift silently until a new trait becomes reachable.
